name: dfm-store
description: dataflow marketing: where a business's objects are kept. store-add names a store and a binding in settings; store-check proves each binding can be read; objects-read lists every object of a kind with where it is and its version; object-read reads an object with its version; object-add puts one into an empty place; object-change changes it only if no one else has since, with a backup first and a read back after; object-remove empties it, with a backup first. Files and Ghost member fields. New to dfm: start with dfm-recipes:client-run.
